text:
Every day, I wake up at six in the morning and start with a glass of water. After a quick shower, I spend twenty minutes stretching and doing light exercises, which helps me feel energized. By seven, I sit down for breakfast—usually oatmeal with fruit—while planning my tasks for the day.

My work schedule runs from nine to five, with a short lunch break at noon. I focus on my projects in the morning when I feel most productive. As soon as I finish, I take a thirty-minute walk or ride my bike to clear my head.

Evenings are for cooking dinner, reading, or watching a show with my family. I try to be in bed by ten. This consistent routine keeps me healthy and calm.
